'''Va'too''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who lived during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Sometime before [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master took the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Aargauun]] [[Talia Moonseeker]] as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] apprentice. Four [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after Moonseeker [[Jedi Trials/Legends|became]] a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], Va'too and Moonseeker were part of a [[Jedi assault team/Legends|task force]] sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] to rescue Jedi Knight [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who had been captured during a mission there. However, the rescue attempt turned into a full-scale [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|battle]] with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and Va'too was [[Death/Legends|killed]]. After the battle, Moonseeker ensured that the body of her former Master was retrieved.

==Biography==
Va'too was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individual who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Va'too was taken and [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], reaching the rank of a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and later that of a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. At some point, Va'too took the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Aargauun]] [[Talia Moonseeker]] as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner.<ref name="WS" /> Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> Moonseeker successfully passed her [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]] and became a full-fledged [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight herself.<ref name="WS" />

Four [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later, Jedi Knight [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was captured by forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during a mission on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. Jedi Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] summoned a [[Jedi assault team/Legends|strike team]]<ref name="WS" /> consisting of over 200 Jedi<ref name="Inside AOTC">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref>&mdash;including Va'too and Moonseeker&mdash;to rescue the trio. However, their rescue effort turned into a large [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|battle]] against the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] in the [[Petranaki arena|arena]] where Kenobi was to be executed, and Va'too was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the fighting. When the battle had ended, Moonseeker returned to the arena and mourned the loss of her Master. Afterward, she made sure that Va'too's corpse was carried away from the battlefield.<ref name="WS" />

==Personality and traits==
Moonseeker was fond of Va'too, and she was deeply upset by her former Master's death. Moonseeker ensured that Va'too's remains were carried away from the arena.<ref name="WS" />

==Powers and abilities==
Va'too possessed the knowledge and the skills to become a Jedi Knight and was able to successfully train Moonseeker to Knighthood. Although a fully trained Jedi Master, Va'too was killed in the arena on Geonosis, along with many other Jedi.<ref name="WS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Va'too was mentioned in [[The Clone Wars: Wild Space|''Wild Space'']], a tie-in novel for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. ''Wild Space'' was written by [[Karen Miller]] and published in [[2008]].<ref name="WS" />
